$comment: Issue #1647 — Deno config for the archive export tool.
Same reason as scripts/issue-1644/deno.json: scripts/package.json declares npm
dependencies for the Node scripts alongside these, Deno walks UP from the entrypoint,
finds it, and switches to node_modules resolution — at which point remote specifiers
start resolving against a node_modules directory that scripts/ does not have.
Pinning nodeModulesDir to 'none' keeps this tool on Deno's own cache so it resolves
identically on a laptop, in a spawned worktree (where node_modules is a symlink into
the anchor checkout — COMMS-0130) and in CI.
